verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a reasonable thing to ask of an agent-oriented video editing product, so the axis applies, but the evidence never mentions one. The docs describe a desktop app that runs an MCP server and cloud agents that install Kino on their own machines. Both are separate integration paths, not a documented command-line interface, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
